hooks.prompt: The session is ending. Read the recent conversation, .ai/memory/memory-index.md, .ai/PROJECT_STATUS.md, .ai/context if present, and .ai/temp/import/latest-request.md if it exists. If meaningful work happened, update durable .ai/memory via commit_memory, update PROJECT_STATUS.md/open-items, and update .ai/context only for verified repo navigation drift. If the import request lists tool-native memories/chats, distill only durable project learnings and do not bulk-copy raw chat text. Preserve user intent and do not invent learnings. Context: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=process.env.AI_DIR||p.join(process.cwd(),'.ai');if(!fs.existsSync(d))process.exit(0);try{const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');const s=execFileSync('git',['diff','--name-only'],{cwd:p.resolve(d,'..'),encoding:'utf-8'});if(s.includes('.ai/')){console.log(JSON.stringify({additionalContext:'Sub-agent made .ai/ changes. Consider running sync_memory to persist them.'}))}}catch{}"
